messages:
Priya K: Hey folks — quick ping. PR #4871 updates the optimizer batching heuristic to prefer age-based draining over size in some cases. Requesting runtime + platform + infra + sec eyes before we schedule the canary. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/4871
Jamal R: @Priya K can you paste perf numbers + what tests you ran? specifically interested in 8k/16k seq p95/p99 and any tail regressions
Priya K: perf summary: p95 tokens/sec +12% on our batchy chat sim, p99 unchanged at 8k. 16k runs show ~8% improvement p95, p99 within noise. Ran unit/e2e eval suite (50k dialogs) and finetune smoke. ci build passed.
ci-bot: CI build #534 passed — unit tests ok, integration smoke ok, lint ✅
Alex M: platform note: does this change routing or require orch flags? if it adds a runtime flag we need an orch config change and a canary rollout plan in the console
Priya K: No routing changes. Adds a runtime flag `--optimizer-tilt` (default false). Sample config snippet:```
optimizer:
  tilt: true
  drain_age_ms: 20
```
Priya K: Canary plan I'm proposing: 10% traffic for 2h, then 50% for 1h, full if no regressions. Target maintenance window Tue 10:00 PST.
Samir (infra): infra questions: any kernel/bpf/native alloc changes? also what's memory delta at peak? need perf mem traces to sign off
Priya K: No kernel or bpf changes. Peak memory +3% on our test rigs. Uploading perf flame & heap snapshots: https://internal.redwood/perf/4871
Taylor (sec): sec quick-check: does this touch auth, change any logging of request payloads, or introduce new telemetry that could contain PII? KMS usage unchanged?
Priya K: Confirmed: no auth surface changes, no additional request payload logging, telemetry unchanged. KMS usage unchanged.
Jamal R: runtime side — I'll run an overnight 16k seq p99 sweep and a long tail regression job. If that looks good I'll own runtime rollback during canary.
Alex M: I'll draft the canary playbook and schedule the window once we have J's p99 check. Who is the rollback owner? @Jamal R or @Samir (infra)?
Jamal R: I can own rollback during the canary window (monitor + revert).
Priya K: tagging @Taylor (sec) for final sec LGTM and @Alex M for platform scheduling
Taylor (sec): LGTM from sec, no blockers
Jamal R: runtime tentative +1 pending final p99 tonight. If that passes I'll post final +1 here.
Priya K: awesome — thanks all. I'll hold merge until Jamal posts final p99 and then merge into main and trigger the canary plan. Appreciate the quick eyes :tada:
thread_summary: PR 4871 requests cross-team approvals for an optimizer batching change; participants ask for perf numbers, infra/memory impacts, platform rollout plan, and security checks. CI passed; sec LGTM; runtime to run final p99 check; canary owner assigned.
